Hymn 66: Rejoice, the Lord Is King!
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: John Darwall
Lyricist/Text Author: Charles Wesley
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 66 titled "Rejoice, the Lord Is King!" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by John Darwall and the lyrics were written by Charles Wesley.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
